verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official, first-party Auth0 CLI, documented on its docs site for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks, and integrating into development and deployment workflows. A probe also confirms the official repository at github.com/auth0/auth0-cli. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-friendly CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive agent use), detailed command coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
